about: Every line DAYBOOK 0.5.0 can say, with an id. This is the recording script.
A line with {slots} is spoken by joining recorded pieces: the fixed words, then a part from a bank.
Slots: {time} comes from the "time" bank; {name} is her name, recorded on her device only.
See docs/VOICE.md for how each part is recorded (carrier sentences, two tones) and joined.
Free text from the calendar is shown on screen, never spoken.

lines.text: Here's a thought for today.

lines.text: There's something good in every day. Sometimes it's as simple as a warm cup of tea.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: You've seen a great deal in your life, and you've come through all of it. That's something to be proud of.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: No rush today. Things can go at your own pace.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: A little sunshine through the window can brighten a whole room.

lines.text: A good laugh is worth more than a spotless kitchen.

lines.text: It's a fine day to be kind to yourself.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: Somebody out there is smiling because they know you.

lines.text: Every season has its own kind of beauty. So does every age.

lines.text: You don't have to do everything today. One or two things is plenty.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: Good music has a way of lifting the heart. Maybe put something nice on today.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: A tidy corner, a full cup, a comfortable chair. Simple things are good things.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: You have a kind way about you. People notice it.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: Whatever the weather does, a cosy spot indoors is always there.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: It's nice to stop for a moment and just enjoy where you are.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: Fresh air does wonders, even a few minutes by an open door.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: You've made a lot of people's lives better over the years.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: Listen for a bird outside. They're usually busy with something cheerful.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: Being yourself is more than enough.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: A phone call to someone you love can brighten two days at once.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: Good things often come quietly.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: Take a deep breath and let your shoulders drop. There. That's better.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: Your stories are worth telling. Somebody would love to hear one.
lines.when: Start of the day: the thought of the day (one per date, rotating).

lines.text: There's no wrong way to enjoy a slow day.

time.about: Appointment times, rounded to the nearest quarter hour (the exact time is on screen). 12-hour, no a.m./p.m., no year. Each part is recorded twice: mid-sentence tone and end-of-sentence tone.

name.about: Her name, recorded on her device only. Never written in any file that is committed. The placeholder voice reads it from the local config.
